prompt: Write an email to introduce myself to a new stakeholder at a partner company in London

assertions.name: formal-register
assertions.description: Uses formal English register (Dear [Name/Sir/Madam], full sentences)

assertions.name: no-contractions
assertions.description: Body does not use contractions (I'm, I've, we're, etc.)

assertions.name: specific-subject-line
assertions.description: Subject is specific and descriptive (not just 'Introduction')

assertions.name: introduces-roger
assertions.description: Introduces Roger by name and provides relevant professional context

assertions.name: clear-call-to-action
assertions.description: Ends with a clear next step (e.g., suggests a call or meeting)

assertions.name: no-padding-phrases
assertions.description: Does not contain 'I hope this email finds you well', 'please don't hesitate', or similar filler
